title: Book One · Chapter 99: Eight Candles in Pencil
story:
On Ronan's eighth birthday, there is no large cake.

Mum makes a round steamed bun. There is a little sweet filling inside. Dad draws eight candles on a scrap of paper. He stands the paper behind the plate.

“You cannot blow those out,” Ronan says.

“Try gently. These candles go down very easily.”

Ronan blows. Dad folds the picture down at once.

“Excellent wind.”

Mum laughs. Ronan asks for another turn. Dad lifts the paper and the eight candles stand up again.

They eat the bun in three pieces. Ronan's piece has the most filling. He notices and gives Mum a little of it. Then he takes his next bite.

Dad gives him a small packet of plain drawing paper. Mum sewed a strong cloth cover for his pencil tin. It has a loop to hold the yellow ruler. The ruler often slides out of his bag.

Ronan likes both things. He also looks once towards the corner by the door. No bicycle is standing there.

Mum sees the look. She does not pretend she has not.

“We did not buy a bicycle this year,” she says. “We need our money for other things.”

“I know.”

“You may still be disappointed.”

He runs his hand over the cloth cover. “I like this.”

“I hoped you would.”

Ronan likes his present. He still wants a bicycle. Mum does not ask him to stop feeling sad.

After breakfast, he puts one coin into his savings box. No one gave him this coin because he was good. He chose not to spend it at the stall.

“Do you want to write the amount?” Dad asks. They count together. The total is still small. Ronan writes it on a folded paper inside the lid. He does not draw a bicycle beside the number yet.

At school, Leo gives him a little ship picture. The ship has eight chimneys. Mei says no ship needs so many. Leo says it is a birthday ship, not a sensible one.

Mei gives Ronan a paper bookmark. She has drawn three small waves at the bottom. She left the top blank for his name. He writes it himself.

Mum packed some dried fruit. The three share it during break. There is not enough fruit for the whole class. Miss Wu asks the three to wait. They can eat it when they sit outside together. Ronan feels embarrassed at first. Then he looks at the other children. He does not want them to feel left out.

In the afternoon, the class tests one last boat. Ronan writes down the test result. He puts no birthday pictures on the test page.

That evening, Dad stands the candle paper up once more. Ronan blows, Mum folds it, and Dad acts surprised.

“I was not ready.”

“Then you missed the wind,” Ronan says.

Before bed, he puts the paper candles with the old rough map. The new drawing paper goes beside his red sail book. The cloth cover holds his tin shut. The tin stays quiet inside it. He lies down and looks towards his new things. They are close enough to touch from his bed. There is still no new bicycle outside the door.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- filling＝馅
- other things＝其他事情需要的东西
- savings＝积蓄
- bookmark＝书签

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：steamed bun＝馒头；loop＝套环；chimney＝烟囱；candles＝蜡烛。

## 读句提示

**Do you want to write the amount?**

你想／写下／数额吗？一个直接问题，不叠加if与how much。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样同时喜欢礼物又感到失望？
2. 家人怎样用普通物品庆祝八岁生日？
